correctness.rationale: The decomposition into global, between-block and within-block subspaces is exact and complete. Strict monotonicity of the scalar ratio orders all three eigenvalues. Every PSD rank-one correction must retain an unchanged within-block Rayleigh direction while it cannot increase the between-block Rayleigh quotient, giving the universal sharp lower bound. A global projector correction attains the bound on the exact derived nonempty interval; an independent checker passed 4,216 rational, symbolic-matrix, and numerical consistency assertions. This is an analytic proof, not finite extrapolation.

value.rationale: The recent large-scale KRR block preconditioner explicitly leaves inter-block coarse corrections open. The present complete sharp one-dimensional correction design demonstrates an O(m)-growing preconditioned condition number repaired to an O(s)-only fixed-block-width bound with one global dot product, and proves no other PSD rank-one denominator correction can improve the result. This tests the method at a natural coherence boundary, not an arbitrary finite slice; no general-kernel or runtime extrapolation is claimed.
